payload.reason: The evidence provides specific numerical improvements over previously reported results in speculation detection and scope resolution, indicating that the new methods outperformed earlier approaches.

claims.text: The reported improvements over previously reported results include at least 0.29 F1 points on cue detection and 4.27 F1 points on scope resolution.
XLNet consistently outperformed BERT and RoBERTa, which contrasts with results on other benchmark datasets.
On the negation scope resolution task, XLNet and RoBERTa achieved a gain of 3.16 F1 points on BF, 0.06 F1 points on BA, and 0.3 F1 points on SFU.
